descriptions.phpstan: PHPStan at the maximum level, then the witnesses that prove each forbidden call is still reported.
descriptions.deptrac: The layers, generated from the composer.json and phil-dev.php of each package.
descriptions.test:services: The Integration suite against the MySQL, PostgreSQL and Gotenberg of phil-dev services.
descriptions.infection: Mutation testing of the whole code at 100 % of covered mutants.
descriptions.infection:changed: Mutation testing of the files changed since the base ref (PHIL_DEV_BASE_REF, else origin/main), once per batch.
descriptions.test:next: The tests on the next PHP of the matrix, in its Docker image.
descriptions.infection:next: Mutation testing of the whole code on the next PHP of the matrix, weekly and before a release.
descriptions.docs: The documentation checks of each package.
descriptions.packages: Each package installed on its own, with its dependency analysis and its tests.
descriptions.packages:next: The same, on the next PHP of the matrix.
descriptions.gates: Every quality gate, in order: the slow checks are scripts of their own.
descriptions.test: The tests with ParaTest, one process per core, or PHPUnit when ParaTest is missing.
descriptions.twig: The code style of the Twig templates, with Twig-CS-Fixer.
descriptions.twigstan: The Twig templates analysed by TwigStan; a script of its own.
descriptions.js: The Stimulus controllers and other scripts, checked by Biome.
descriptions.bench:baseline: The benchmarks, stored as the baseline of this machine.
descriptions.bench:compare: The benchmarks against the baseline, failing above the threshold of bench.threshold.
descriptions.bench:worker: A page served by FrankenPHP in worker mode, measured.
descriptions.deps:audit: The installed packages against the security advisories.
descriptions.deps:unused: The required packages the code never uses, with composer-unused.
descriptions.taint: The taint analysis of Psalm on the production code; a script of its own.
descriptions.fuzz: The fuzz targets of the packages, each for its time budget; a script of its own.
descriptions.sbom: The CycloneDX bill of materials of each package, under var/phil-dev/sbom/.
descriptions.bc: The public API against the latest tag, for backward-compatibility breaks.
descriptions.hotspots: The files that change most and are the most complex, with churn-php.
descriptions.docs:lint: The prose of the documentation, with cspell, markdownlint and Vale; a script of its own.
descriptions.docs:translations: The French mirror of the documentation of each package, blocking or advisory by docs.translations.
descriptions.lint:apps: The container, the expressions and the YAML of each functional test application, through its own console.
descriptions.hooks: Installs the git hooks of captainhook.json: the fast gates on the staged files before each commit.
descriptions.split: The finished packages split to their public repositories; dry run unless --push is given.
